build_SunRgbdImVoxelHead: build a SunRgbdImVoxelHead for 3D object detection on SUN RGB-D dataset with centerness and bbox regression
build_ScanNetImVoxelHead: build a ScanNetImVoxelHead for 3D object detection on ScanNet dataset without yaw angle regression
review_ImVoxelHead_forward_train: review the ImVoxelHead forward_train method that computes centerness, bbox, and classification losses
test_compute_centerness: test the compute_centerness function that calculates 3D centerness targets from bbox min/max distances
refactor_ImVoxelHead_get_targets: refactor the ImVoxelHead get_targets method to assign ground truth labels to feature map points
